name: ml-dev-bench
description: ml-dev-bench is a small development-oriented benchmark suite hosted on Hugging Face for quick evaluation of machine learning models during model development. It is intended to measure basic task performance and correctness across lightweight datasets meant for debugging and iteration rather than large-scale model comparison. The suite emphasizes fast turnaround and reproducibility for common development workflows.
reputation: Niche utility dataset with limited community adoption, mainly used for quick development and debugging rather than benchmark competitions.
